name: Studio
description: Editorial and bold, like a product studio's feed: a tight bold grotesk in cream or near-black on a red, black or cream page, one coloured final word, numbered rows on thin rules, report covers with a short red line, yellow highlights and pills.

compositions.name: Red field
compositions.describe: A big tight white headline low on the red field, any [[marked]] words on yellow highlight pills, a short sub line under it, the label top right and the web address and Swipe at the foot. For a bold claim of up to about 70 characters.

compositions.name: Report cover
compositions.describe: A "state of" report cover on the dark page: a short red line, the label in small capitals, the headline large in white and the emphasised phrase as a red second line under it, a short sub line below. Needs an emphasised phrase of up to 40 characters.

compositions.name: Final word
compositions.describe: The headline large in near-black on the cream page with its emphasised final word in red, the label in red capitals above it and a sub line under it. For a statement of up to about 70 characters.

compositions.name: Report figure
compositions.describe: One huge white figure on the dark page under a short red line and the label, what it counts in red under it and a sub line with the fact behind it. For a single number of up to 8 characters.

compositions.name: Red figure
compositions.describe: One huge cream figure on the red field with what it counts beside the label above it and a sub line under it. For a single number of up to 8 characters.

compositions.name: Numbered rows
compositions.describe: The headline in white on the dark page with its emphasised final word in red, and the items as numbered rows (01, 02 ...) on thin rules under it, the web address and Swipe at the foot. For two to five short words or points.

compositions.name: Job post
compositions.describe: A job post on the cream page: the role as a big light title with its emphasised end (a full stop) in red, a sub line, the requirements as small rows on red number tiles and a drawn phone outline at the right. Two to five requirements.

compositions.name: Red rows
compositions.describe: The headline in cream on the red field and the items as numbered rows on thin rules at the foot, the label top right. For two to five short steps or points.

compositions.name: Dark quote
compositions.describe: A red opening quotation mark, the quotation large in bold white on the dark page and the source in red capitals under a short red line. For a quotation of up to about 160 characters.

compositions.name: Red quote
compositions.describe: The quotation large in cream on the red field with the source under it in capitals, the label top right. For a quotation of up to about 140 characters.

compositions.name: Photo on red
compositions.describe: The headline in cream at the top of the red field, any [[marked]] words on yellow pills, and the picture as a wide panel under it, the web address and Swipe at the foot. For a photograph with a headline of up to 64 characters.

compositions.name: Photo with a dark fade
compositions.describe: The picture over the whole page under an even dark fade, the headline centred low on it in bold cream with any [[marked]] words on yellow pills, the label above it. For a photograph with a headline of up to 70 characters.

compositions.name: Photo with a caption block
compositions.describe: The picture over the whole page with a dark block across its lower middle holding the headline in bold cream, a short sub line under it. For a photograph with a question or a headline of up to 64 characters.

compositions.name: Speaker card
compositions.describe: A speaker card on the dark page: the tag on a yellow pill, the event name huge with a red emphasised end, the session under it, the picture on a red block, and a two-colour footer: the meta line on a red strip, When and Where rows on yellow.

compositions.name: Red poster
compositions.describe: An event poster on the red field: the label, the headline huge in cream, the date and place as rows on thin rules, a row of round speaker pictures and a cream button with the call to action. For an event with a headline of up to 48 characters.

compositions.name: Application
compositions.describe: An application post on the cream page with a ribbon across the top right corner: the tag on a dark pill, the label in red capitals, the headline large with its emphasised final word in red, a sub line, and the closing date or call to action on a yellow pill at the foot.

compositions.name: Work with us
compositions.describe: An offer on the red field: the tag huge in cream, the headline under it, the picture as a panel at the right when there is one, a sub line and a cream button with the call to action at the foot.
